name: architect-pm-handoff
description: A role-based lead-AI workflow for planning, context-efficient execution capsules, and implementation review.

interface.longDescription: Use a designated lead AI to inspect a repository, preserve durable Task Specs, create bounded per-attempt Execution Capsules for downstream agents, and review results in separate records.
defaultPrompt: Use Architect PM Handoff as the lead AI to plan this requirement and create an Execution Capsule.
Use Architect PM Handoff to review the current attempt and record a separate Review Record.
